rows: NLTL SHACL evaluation framework — defensible metric map
Use published metrics where the required evidence exists. Label every adaptation and keep the four evaluation layers separate.
Did this architecture produce a reviewable SHACL artifact for the requirement?
Report available artifacts / 268. Do not call this SHACL accuracy.
Denominator: all 268 requirements; unavailable outputs remain unavailable, not parse failures.
Does the parsed shapes graph conform to SHACL structural requirements?
Conditional denominator: parsed artifacts only. Report unsupported SHACL-SPARQL cases separately.
Are sh: predicates standard rather than hallucinated?
Does generated RDF structure match a gold shapes graph?
Not computable because NLTL has no reference SHACL. Do not substitute human preference for a gold graph.
Which SHACL constructs and complexity levels occur?
SHACLEval criteria-based measures; NL2SHACL component coverage
Report counts/coverage by target, component, Core/SPARQL, path depth and logical nesting. These are not correctness scores.
Did the shape select the intended focus node in the audited cases?
Project adaptation motivated by NL2SHACL ASER limitations
Record all/some/no target. A conforming result with no relevant target cannot support semantic correctness.
Did the generated shape return the expected PASS/FAIL on frozen cases?
Task-based adaptation of NL2SHACL ASER; ERA expected-outcome correctness
Call it behavioral agreement, not logical equivalence.
How often did an expected violation incorrectly conform?
State denominator explicitly: expected-FAIL cases with an executable verdict; report no-verdict separately.
How often did an expected conforming case incorrectly violate?
State denominator explicitly: expected-PASS cases with an executable verdict; report no-verdict separately.
What is accuracy when each regulation receives equal weight?
Average each requirement's case accuracy, then average requirements. Keep separate from case-weighted accuracy.
How many regulations passed every available frozen case?
Report exact successes / 268 and availability/no-verdict separately.
Does the code faithfully implement the maritime requirement and ontology?
Criteria grounded in NL2SHACL error categories; domain-specific operationalization
Primary result is Correct/Minor/Major/Not assessable. Numeric score is secondary.
Is the artifact inspectable, maintainable, internally consistent and diagnostically useful?
Project adaptation using SHACLEval GQM/ROMEO and ERA report comprehensiveness
Do not merge implementation quality with semantic correctness.
Does each selected case represent the intended regulation and expected verdict?
Audit one PASS and one FAIL case per requirement where available; correct confirmed benchmark defects transparently.
Are manual decisions reproducible between reviewers?
Double-review a stratified 10–20% subset; report agreement and adjudication procedure.
Normative SHACL concepts, validation reports and terminology
The standard defines the language, not a grading rubric.
RDF/Spec/Vocab validity; structural and semantic metric taxonomy; error categories
EMR, PMS, ASER or LER as published
EMR/PMS/ASER/LER require a reference SHACL or reference-shape-generated data; its current dataset excludes SHACL-SPARQL.
NLTL evaluates generated shapes, not competing validation engines.
Descriptive construct measures and Goal–Question–Metric justification
Its measures characterize shape structure and must be tied to project goals.
Astrea maps ontology axioms to SHACL; it does not provide a gold-free manual NL-to-SHACL scoring scale.
